page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with a centred heading and a table of verb forms. Running head at the top. Small labels in the left margin beside the table rows (Indicat., Verbera bam., Verbera ui., Verbera-ueram.) and a section letter "a" in the left margin beside the paragraph "Etiā".

main_text.p: polysyllabi, manet. ἡγεῖος, ἡγερᾶς, ἥγερκα. In infinito autem primo utrunque migrat in ει. ἀπεῖος, ἀπερῶ, ἐἀπεῖσα. ἡγεῖος, ἐἰς ρᾶς, ἥγεσα. νέμω, νεμῶ, ᾠνειμα.
aEtiā a in futuri penultima, in infinito primo transit in η. φάλλω, φαλῶ, ἔφηλα.

page.notes: Greek forms are read from a small, worn scan; several accents and breathings are uncertain and should be checked against the original. The left-margin labels were treated as notes beside the table rows. The catchword "Infi-" at the foot is a catchword, not a paragraph, so it may belong in the catchword element. The section letter "a" beside "Etiā" is the printed marginal mark.
